/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Mop Dock Auto Repair
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: If the mops don't stay wet during cleaning, there might be air in the system,preventing the water tank in the robot from being filled. In that case, try running this a few times.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Drain internal water tank
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Drain the internal water tank of the robot into the dock. This can be useful if the robot is to be transported or stored for a while. May take up to 3 minutes.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Mop Dock Cleaning Process
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Trigger a manual base cleaning. The robot needs to be docked. Keep a brush ready and follow the instructions the robot will give you.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Water Hookup Test
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Test if the permanent water hookup has been installed correctly. Listen to the robots' voice prompts for status updates. If errors should occur, they will be raised as ValetudoEvents.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Carpet Mode Sensitivity
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Depending on the type of carpet in your home, the carpet mode might not trigger as expected. This tunable can help in these situations.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Mop Cleaning Frequency
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Determine how often the robot should clean and re-wet its mopping pads during a cleanup.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Detergent
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Select if the Dock should automatically add detergent to the water

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Pre-Wet Mops
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Select "dry" if you don't want the dock to wet the mops before cleaning. This can be useful if there's a spill that you want to mop up.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Deep carpet cleaning
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: When enabled, the robot will automatically slowly clean detected carpets with twice the cleanup passes in alternating directions.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Mop Dock Mop Wash Intensity
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Higher settings mean more water and longer wash cycles.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Edge Extension: Side Brush
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Automatically extend the side brush to further reach into corners or below furniture.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Edge Extension: Frequency
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Select when/how often mop and side brush (each when enabled) should be extended to increase coverage in corners and close to walls.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Detach Mops
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: When enabled, the robot will leave the mop pads in the dock when running a vacuum-only cleanup.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Side Brush on Carpet
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: Select if the side brush should spin when cleaning carpets.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Carpet First
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: When enabled, the robot will first clean all carpet areas before then continuing with the rest of the cleanup.

/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.title: Fan Speed Turbo
/api/v2/robot/capabilities/QuirksCapabil.description: When enabled, the next cleanup will be done with even higher suction power. Disables itself afterwards.
